domain: Microarchitecture / Asynchronous State Machine Simulation / Network Flow
scoring_method: Exact Match SHA-256 Hex Digest of Canonical Simulation Trace Log

external_solvability.evidence: Every problem instance in items_private_sample.jsonl includes the full network topology, queue capacities, node opcodes, initial 32-bit registers, dynamic routing policies, injection schedule, and cycle count. solver_packet.md provides a complete, deterministic, cycle-by-cycle microarchitecture phase specification with unambiguous tie-breaking and 32-bit arithmetic rules.

novelty_and_differentiation.why_not_a_duplicate: Unlike standard LeetCode problems (LiveCodeBench) or natural language instruction following, RADN-Sim tests cycle-accurate concurrent microarchitecture state machine tracing. It requires tracking discrete clock cycle phases, dynamic backpressure stalls, priority queue tie-breaking, and bitwise state transformations simultaneously. Naive zero-shot LLMs and flawed simulators achieve near zero (0-6.7%), while a correct simulator achieves 100%.
